a.name: Photo shelf
a.description: The litter table in one raised card, each row led by that pup's own photo on a bone mat; phones get two-up portrait cards.
a.differs_from: Airy photo-led rows in a raised card that become two-up portrait cards on phones; London's pick is a compact roster sunk in a tray, and the built tables carry no photos.

b.name: Steel ledger
b.description: The litter table on a full-width steel band: compact ruled rows, a token swatch beside each coat, prices in the display face.
b.differs_from: A compact imageless ledger on a steel band with coat swatches; London's pick is a photo roster in a tray, and the built tables are ruled, zebra in a card, or brass-ruled on the page.

c.name: Boy or girl
c.description: One puppy per row, split into a boys group and a girls group side by side, each headed by a puppy photo and its one price.
c.differs_from: Refresh delta, layout: London's sideways table (attributes as rows, boys and girls as columns) becomes the outline's puppy-per-row table in two photo-headed row groups side by side. Differs from London's pick on all four axes.
